what: Clouds·decor images drift very slowly within ±30px around their spot through five points (30,−15 → −25,20 → 20,25 → −30,−20 → 0) over 60s, and when finished they trace back in reverse (alternate). Giving each cloud a different length·curve, 50·60s, ease-out·ease-in-out, makes the sky breathe out of step as if alive

options.--fx-dur: Length of one pass (via style), default 60s — original third and fourth clouds 50s
options.--fx-ease: Curve (via style), default ease-in-out — original first and fourth are ease-out
options.--fx-amp: Drift distance multiplier of the base type (via style), default 1 (±30px)
options.look: square: Path looping through four points (20,−10 → −15,15 → 10,−20) (original cloudAnimate3)

note: CSS only. If placed inside a fixed (position: fixed) sky layer, it floats around regardless of scroll

from.where: index.html .nh-cloud__i — original cloud_1~4: cloudAnimate1·2 60s (ease-out·ease-in-out) · cloudAnimate3·4 50s (ease-in-out·ease-out) · infinite alternate
